scope: LIVE TEST registry (twin/sensors/FEED.md, "Live test with a phone"). Loaded ONLY with ?sensors=live&feed=<private-LAN or localhost URL>; the public ?sensors=demo views read registry.json and never this file. One temporary test device: the owner's phone accelerometer, posting real measurements through tools/sensor_gateway.py on the laptop (data_source gateway, the same adapter path a real wireless gateway will use). It is not a permanent Grimes sensor and is not mounted on the duct: the anchor says which BIM element the test stands in for.

sensors.label: Test device: phone accelerometer
sensors.kind: Temporary test device · phone accelerometer, vibration RMS · via laptop gateway

reading.value: Live acceleration RMS from the phone (m/s², gravity removed)
reading.detail: RMS of the phone's linear acceleration magnitude over each 2 s window, per-axis mean removed. Acceleration, not ISO 10816 velocity (mm/s): a phone cannot integrate to velocity honestly.

test_device.note: Temporary test device for the end-to-end live path; not mounted on duct 399665 and not calibrated. Held or placed by hand.

sensors.provenance: Live test: real measurements from the owner's phone accelerometer (tools/sensor-phone.html) received by tools/sensor_gateway.py on the laptop. Temporary, uncalibrated, not mounted on the duct.
